messages.subject: CairoPDF in downloadHandler
parts:
I have a need to use CairoPDF to handle a few idiosyncracies of labels/titles on plots that I do in Shiny, but am unable to have CairoPDF succeed inside downloadHandler.

For example:
output$downloadPlot <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() { paste("test2.pdf") },
  content = function(file1) {
    pdf(file1)
    makeplot()
    dev.off()
  })
successfully produces a pdf file of my plot, on click of the Download button I created in ui.R

However,
output$downloadPlot <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() { paste("test2.pdf") },
  content = function(file1) {
    CairoPDF(file1)
    makeplot()
    dev.off()
  })
fails.  Click of the Download buttion issues a new browser window with a perpetual "connecting" message, and the R console issues the following errors:
Listening on http://127.0.0.1:5538
Error opening file: 2
Error reading: 6

Please note that this behavior is not dependent on idiosyncracies of my makeplot() function.  Same thing happens with hist(faithful$waiting).

In addition, both pdf and CairoPDF succeed on my platform when executed outside of shiny, with the same graphing functions.

R3.1.1
Shiny 0.10.1
Cairo 1.5.6

Windows 7
RStudio  0.98.1028

What have I missed?
Thanks,
Bruce

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: CairoPDF in downloadHandler
parts:
Sorry for the lack of reply earlier.

I just looked at your example app, the problem is that CairoPDF takes the file1 path and automatically appends ".pdf" to it. So the PDF data ends up being written to the wrong filename, and when Shiny goes to read file1 it doesn't find it.

Adding this line to the end of your handler fixes it:

if (file.exists(paste0(file1, ".pdf")))
  file.rename(paste0(file1, ".pdf"), file1)
